chunks: And from him (Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub) from Al-Nadr from Al-Halabi from Al-Harith ibn Al-Mughirah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
My father (peace be upon him) used to say: 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' equals one-third of the Quran, and he loved to recite it in the Witr prayer so that the entire Quran would be recited.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reports that his father, Imam Al-Baqir (peace be upon him), stated that reciting the Surah Al-Ikhlas ('Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad') is equivalent in reward to one-third of the Quran. Consequently, he preferred to recite it during the Witr prayer to ensure the recitation of the entire Quran.
